entities.name: PMID:25093045
observations: 2014 Clinical Epigenetics study measured leukocyte ABCA1 promoter methylation at eight CpGs in 88 men.
ASA therapy associated with 3.6% lower methylation (P=0.006), adjusted for age and CAD.
Men aged ≥61 had higher methylation than men <61 (38.0±1.2 vs 35.2±1.0; P=0.02).
Men with prior CAD had higher methylation than men without CAD (38.7±1.2 vs 36.0±1.0; P=0.04).
